name: mod-heads-up
description: While Claude works, a side check now and then flags one thing you should understand and probably missed: a card above the prompt, and a Heads up panel with every note of the session by turn

enabled.title: Check while Claude works
enabled.description: Every sixth step of a turn, at most once per turn, a side check reads the session for one thing worth flagging. Off, it makes no request

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait. Hover colors also fade. Off, everything draws still

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when the terminal's font is a Nerd Font (read from Windows Terminal, iTerm2, VS Code, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, GNOME Terminal or Konsole) and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
